deleteAccount.title: Remove Account
deleteAccount.confirmDescription: Confirm your Agriwings credentials to delete your account permanently.

warning.description1:
Removing your account is permanent and cannot be undone.
All your data will be lost, including your profile, spray history, and any other associated information.

error.label: Error
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.network: Unable to reach the server. Please check your connection and try again.

toast.title: We'll miss you!
toast.message: Your account has been removed successfully from AgriWings

updatePassword.title: Update Password
updatePassword.description: Choose a new password with at least 8 characters.

validation.minLength: New password must be at least {{count}} characters.
validation.notMatch: New password and confirmation do not match.
validation.sameAsOld: New password must be different from the old password.

toast.successMessage: Your password has been changed successfully. You have been logged out of all other devices.
